recipes.title: Air-fried cauliflower plate
steps: Air fry the cauliflower until the edges brown.
Serve with rotis and a bowl of moong dal.
recipes.store: Best fresh; the dal keeps a day in the fridge.
recipes.swap: Use tofu in place of the dal.
recipes.fits: A hot dinner with the day's largest protein share.
